title: How to organize the landing surface or console | Stair Landing
description:
A small surface beside the stairs that holds a lamp and a landing spot, without becoming the house's holding pen for things headed to another floor.

This is the Landing Surface or Console in the Stair Landing. About 15-30 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Three permanent things on the console top, say a lamp, a framed photo and one tray, with the tray holding nothing that was there yesterday. The lamp cord runs down the back leg in a clip, not across the walking side. One stair basket sits on the floor at the end nearest the top step, and it is empty.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Take everything off the console top and out of its drawer in one sweep.
Straighten: Put the tray at the end of the console nearest the top step, where your hand lands as you turn, not at the dec
Shine: Wipe the console top, the front edge where hips and bags push past, and the top rim of the lamp shade, which c
Safety: Nothing on this surface may overhang the stair side, not by a centimetre.
Standardize: Write the count into the surface itself: three permanent items plus one tray on top, and one basket on the flo
Sustain: Whoever switches off the landing light at night carries the stair basket up or down and brings it back empty.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Three permanent items plus one tray on top, nothing overhanging the stair side, and one stair basket that sleeps empty.
